name: academia-industry-portal-backend
description: Phase 13 — minimal, dependency-free Node API layer for real-time industry data integration and server-side auth. Keeps external API credentials and password hashes off the frontend, persists users/sessions/per-user LinkedIn tokens in SQLite, and normalizes job-market data for the existing Phase 1-12 dashboards. Uses only Node's built-in http and node:sqlite modules — no npm install required.
